reason: Wrong direction for this category (docs now readable, 2026-09-25, headless Chromium): the Wayfair Developer Portal introduction (https://developer.wayfair.io/posts/introduction) says 'this Developer Portal supports integration for suppliers who are already selling with Wayfair and have Partner Home access' and lists supplier-facing GraphQL APIs - Catalog (manage your product listings), Inventory (Drop-Ship and CastleGate stock), Orders ('handle purchase orders, registrations, labels, cancellations'), CastleGate Fulfillment/Forwarding and Advertising - with applications and keys created after signing in with Partner Home credentials. Wayfair is the buyer on these APIs (it sends you purchase orders); there is no API for buying from Wayfair, so this category's supplier catalogue search, shipping quote and create_order have no counterpart. An adapter would belong with the sales channels, and even there app creation needs a Partner Home (seller) login.
